title: Monotonicity of strict circuit size bounds
statement: For functions $T,T' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and a language $L$ over Boolean strings, if $L$ is recognized by a strict circuit family of size at most $T(n)$ at every input length $n$, and $T(n) \leq T'(n)$ for every $n$, then $L$ is recognized by a strict circuit family of size at most $T'(n)$ at every input length $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ belongs to the strict size class with bound $T$
